scope: One passing current exact-app photo/label/local-model/checked-amount/Save/relaunch/History/detail/delete/second-relaunch case. Separate from the earlier selected-name-to-Review comparison and blank cancellation test.

execution.durationLimit: Automation and assertion time, not human completion time or model latency.

journey.baseline: Fresh host read verified absent review store and unchanged8mediaoriginals.
journey.input: One already-exposed meal photo and one separate synthetic label; description blank.
journey.model: Actual full successful local-model detail observed; namesStatus true, emptyStatus false. One request in this case.
journey.OCR: AX readback contains Total Carbohydrate 37 g matching this synthetic fixture; no automatic amount conversion.
journey.beforeEntry: No reliable range and no final Review. Separate label amount form initially blank, Add disabled.
journey.checkedEntry: Unique synthetic QA item typed, grams remained blank/Add disabled; synthetic 37 typed separately, Add enabled and committed as Your entry.
journey.confirmation: Review disabled until explicit parts confirmation, then enabled.
journey.Save: One local review saved; photo-not-copied caption observed.
journey.firstRelaunch: One history row, neutral Your meal review title, photo provenance and synthetic 37 g.
journey.detail: Unique QA item, Your entry and37g read back in the displayed Saved review; explicit combined Meal source/Your on-device photo also retained and visually confirmed.
journey.delete: Only owned QA detail eligible. Two nested confirmation aliases had identical identifier,label,frame and hittability; one guarded action activated. No Delete All.
journey.secondRelaunch: Zero indexed rows, No saved reviews yet, Delete All disabled. Host store absent after final-record deletion.

matcherLimit: The native exact standalone photo-source query can match the History layer behind the sheet. Root separately verified the combined detail-specific AX label and the actual displayed detail screenshot; no claim that the standalone assertion alone proves detail provenance. Frozen harness unchanged during execution.

artifactRecheck.initialCheck: A naive raw-checkout equality check stopped at intentionally English-only Info.plist. That failed check is retained; corrected comparison uses exact extraction plus Swift source equality. No source or package corruption was established.

confirmed: Full successful local-model detail and separate synthetic label text are visible.
A manually typed QA item has blank grams and disabled Add before separate amount entry.
Final Review has neutral title, manually entered37g, no-insulin boundary and Save action.
Saved detail shows personal-photo provenance,37g, unique QA item and Your entry; metadata values fit this captured card.
Second relaunch shows0records, empty history and disabled Delete All.
rootVisualReview.limits: No general recognition/OCR accuracy, other width/text-size/dark/RTL, direct VoiceOver, animation, physical offline or human three-minute completion claim.

limits: One exposed meal and synthetic label, not human-labeled fresh accuracy or worldwide coverage.
No inferred recipe, portion, carbohydrate amount or insulin dose.
Physical camera/airplane-mode, broader accessibility/layout, multi-view/large-image and other model/error/cancel routes remain open.
No App Store/external/public beta or app release; internal upload processing/group state remains separately unverified.
No new binary or duplicate upload because app bytes did not change.
warnings: Retained Xcode SDK-format diagnostics; no causal claim.
privacy: Only curated metadata/hashes public; raw logs, pictures, QA identifiers, review content and private paths stay local.
